idea-plugin.name: Linux Do (API Docs)
idea-plugin.description:
Linux Do — Unofficial Community Client

An independent, personal project by lgguan, licensed under MIT. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Linux Do or JetBrains. Only https://linux.do is supported.

Supports Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires JetBrains IDE 2026.2 (build 262.*) with its bundled JBR and JCEF plugin.

A native JetBrains IDE plugin for browsing Linux Do (Discourse) community forum, featuring:

  • Developer Documentation / Code Camouflage Mode: Integrates seamlessly into the IDE editor with Monospace/JetBrains Mono typography, Git-Log/Issue-tracker style list, and RFC/Javadoc formatted post reader.
  • DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH): Defaults to LinuxDo DoH (https://ldh.ddd.oaifree.com/query-dns). Custom HTTPS resolvers and system DNS are also available.
  • Cloudflare Verification & Auth: Integrated JCEF authentication to solve Cloudflare Turnstile challenges and persist session credentials securely via PasswordSafe.
  • Discourse API Features: Topic lists (Latest, Top, New, Unread), categories filter, full-text search, rich post reading, read progress tracking (/topics/timings sync), and Git-commit style reply composer.
  • Boss Key (Emergency Mode): Hide all topic tabs and the API Docs panel; press again to restore.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: Initial public release. Browse, search, create topics and replies, track reading progress and notifications in a documentation-style interface. Includes private JCEF login, floor navigation, a boss key, and LinuxDo DoH enabled by default.
